review.root_cause: Template-based lead-ins repeated a shortened product name multiple times and inserted it unnaturally into styling notes.
comment_examples: this brown full sleeve shirt - repeated 4 times
this grey round neck t-shirt - repeated 5 times
Styling note - For this green full sleeve shirt, Wear...

rules: Retain one natural product introduction and replace repeated shortened product phrases in subsequent sentences with context-appropriate references.
Rewrite styling-note openings to use 'Wear it with...' rather than reintroducing the full product name.

verification.method: Connector readback of all commented rows plus representative non-commented revised rows.
